description: Returns the amount that arrives for each supplied provider quote, the exchange-rate markup against the ECB reference rate, the total cost as a percent, a ranking, and the World Bank average cost for the receiving country. Inputs are the amount, the two currency codes, and each provider's fee and rate (receiving currency per one unit of sending currency). A rate supplied the other way round is flipped and the flip is noted. With no quotes, the result is the reference rate and the benchmark. Applies to questions about comparing providers for sending money to another country. Not financial advice; Divux does not send money.

quotes.description: One quote per provider: name, fee in the sending currency, and rate.

fee.description: Transfer fee in the sending currency (0 if none)

rate.description: Exchange rate offered: receiving currency per 1 sending currency

receive_amount.description: Amount the provider says arrives, if shown

receive_country.description: Receiving country's two-letter code, e.g. 'MX', for the World Bank benchmark

send_amount.description: Amount being converted, before fees, in the sending currency

name: compare_transfers
title: Money abroad: compare transfer quotes
